name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iran drones at US radar in Bahrain 16 Nov
summary: Iran's Guards claimed drone attacks on US sites in Bahrain on 13, 15 and 16 Nov; US moved a third carrier to the region
state: US Central Command confirmed Iran's Guards launched two drones at Bahrain overnight into 13 Nov, both intercepted, after Trump said on 12 Nov he would renew strikes (Reuters via Jerusalem Post). Iran said it targeted a US radar in Bahrain on 15 Nov (Al Jazeera) and claimed a six-drone attack on 16 Nov that Bahrain said it destroyed; the US moved a third carrier into the region on 15 Nov (Drop Site News). Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Bahrain, Iran and the Gulf, which can change at short notice. Energy prices remain exposed to the conflict.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping = Alert

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
